inspiration: Effect as a short command list: each explosion is a few commands in order: set sprite, set a short timeout, bloom, stop (explosion.c:8-14). Recreate our impact effects as a per-effect command list (sprite, wait, spawn child, stop) in data, so a new hit effect is a table row. Maps to parity row 10 (hit impact) and row 8 (blood and decals).

Eight-facing move table with a pause step: the unit move animation is a table over eight facings and eight steps; each step is one command, some are timed pauses (animation.c:7-10). Recreate as an eight-facing clip table for creature walk and attack, where each step is a command, not an image index. Maps to parity row 7 (creature clips).

Unit flags as data: each unit row carries flags such as shadow, factory, can be picked up, no message on death (unitinfo.c:14-30). Recreate per-creature flags (shadow, can be carried, quiet death) as data fields, not code branches.

Default AI action list per unit type: a short fixed list of AI actions per type (g_table_actionsAI, unitinfo.c:12). Recreate as a per-creature list of default behaviours (hunt, guard, ambush) that the brain walks in order.

Stable string IDs with a per-language pack: 536 enum IDs with the text loaded from a pack at start (strings.h:8; string.c:110). Recreate as stable keys in our locale files, so changing a translation never changes code.

Enhancement list as defect ledger: enhancement.txt lists fixes to the original game's bugs by category, each entry a problem and its fix (enhancement.txt:3). Use the same shape for our donor-defect notes: idea kept, defect and fix listed. Only the head was read.

briefs.label: Lift-and-carry hauler
briefs.why: A flying unit whose job is to lift another unit. Reads at 375 wide as a shadow under a body that carries a load.
briefs.keep: Carries another unit. A shadow on the ground. A flag that says the carried unit can be lifted.
briefs.change: A ray-shaped, bird-like hauler with a glow under the belly rather than a box with rotors. A different load: a fallen ally or a crate. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.

briefs.label: Bloom burst impact
briefs.why: A short, readable hit effect built as a few commands, so it is cheap to draw and easy to tune.
briefs.keep: Three to four steps: sprite, short timeout, bloom, stop.
briefs.change: A shard ring with a sharp flash rather than a round bloom; a colour per damage type. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.

briefs.label: Eight-facing walk table
briefs.why: A walk cycle stored as a table over facings and steps means every creature gets the same timing vocabulary without new code.
briefs.keep: Eight facings. Each step is a command, some timed pauses.
briefs.change: Twelve facings for a spider-like body, with leg-pair steps instead of one frame step. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.
